public_metadata_basis.response_matrix_description: explicit island-by-mammal presence/absence matrix; island ID in rows and mammal species in columns

response_domain.target_one: species present in source presence-absence matrix
response_domain.target_zero: species absent in source presence-absence matrix

claim_population.included: source-curated islands with at least one mammal species and complete source environmental/realm information
claim_population.excluded: islands with zero mammal species according to source IUCN-derived database
claim_population.implication: results cannot be interpreted as colonization probability of mammal-empty islands

temporal_semantics.reason: source matrix restores native species extinct through human activity

ecological_hypothesis.name: global_mammal_source_pool_handoff
ecological_hypothesis.statement: Among mammal-occupied islands, species-conditioned continuity with occupied insular sources should retain occurrence information beyond island area, current mainland isolation, past land-bridge isolation, generic island-network context, and direct/diffuse occupied-source proximity, with the incremental information concentrated in the most currently isolated islands.

primary_regime_prediction.extreme_isolation_variable: source Current_isolation / SLMP coding in which larger values represent greater present isolation
primary_regime_prediction.primary_extreme_rule: upper 25% of frozen model-target current-isolation distribution
primary_regime_prediction.prediction: C_minus_R3 is more favourable in extreme-current-isolation islands than in non-extreme islands

dispersal_mode_secondary.prediction: current source-network continuity should be relatively more informative for bats, whereas past-isolation state should explain a larger share of non-volant occurrence structure
dispersal_mode_secondary.basis: source paper reports stronger current-isolation association for bats and stronger past-isolation association for non-volant mammals

coordinate_provenance.code_only_evidence: published analysis code uses Lat_centroid and Long_centroid from the island analysis object and derives plotting Longitude/Latitude from them
